short_description.id: Poseidon adalah dewa Olimpus dalam agama Yunani kuno yang membawahi laut, badai, gempa bumi, dan kuda, serta pelindung para pelaut.
short_description.en: Poseidon is an Olympian god of ancient Greek religion presiding over the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses, and a protector of seafarers.

long_description.id: Poseidon adalah salah satu dari dua belas dewa Olimpus dalam agama dan mitologi Yunani kuno yang membawahi laut, badai, gempa bumi, dan kuda. Ia pelindung para pelaut dan penjaga banyak kota Helenik. World History Encyclopedia menyebutnya dewa laut dan sungai, pencipta badai dan banjir, serta pelindung pelaut dan pelindung kuda. Theoi menggambarkannya sebagai pria dewasa berbadan kekar dengan janggut gelap yang memegang trisula, yaitu tombak ikan bermata tiga, dan World History Encyclopedia menambahkan bahwa trisula itu dibuat para Kiklops. Menurut Theoi, hewan sucinya adalah banteng, kuda, dan lumba-lumba.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek religion and mythology, Poseidon ranks among the twelve Olympians and has charge of the sea, storms, earthquakes, and horses. He protects seafarers and guards many Hellenic cities. World History Encyclopedia calls him god of seas and rivers, maker of storms and floods, protector of mariners and patron of horses. Theoi depicts him as a mature man of sturdy build with a dark beard holding a trident, a three-pronged fishing spear, and World History Encyclopedia adds that the trident was fashioned by the Cyclopes. According to Theoi, his sacred animals were the bull, the horse and the dolphin.

long_description.id: Dalam Iliad 15, Poseidon sendiri berkata bahwa ia dan Zeus serta Hades adalah tiga bersaudara putra Cronos dan Rhea; ketika undian dikocok ia memperoleh laut kelabu, Hades kegelapan, dan Zeus langit luas, dan Iris menyapanya sebagai "Pemeluk Bumi, dewa berambut gelap". Menurut Theoi, pembagian itu terjadi setelah jatuhnya para Titan dan laut menjadi wilayahnya. Ia dikisahkan ditelan ayahnya, Kronos, saat lahir, dan kemudian bersama saudara-saudaranya mengalahkan dewa-dewa yang lebih tua dengan trisula buatan para Kiklops. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa dalam puisi paling awal ia setara Zeus dalam martabat tetapi lebih lemah.
long_description.en: In Iliad 15, Poseidon himself says that he, Zeus, and Hades are three brethren, sons of Cronos and Rhea; when the lots were shaken he won the grey sea, Hades the murky darkness, and Zeus the broad heaven, and Iris addresses him as "O Earth-Enfolder, thou dark-haired god". According to Theoi, the division happened after the fall of the Titans and the sea became his domain. He is said to have been swallowed by his father Kronos at birth, and later with his brothers he defeated the elder gods using a trident crafted by the Cyclopes. The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that in the earliest poems he is equal to Zeus in dignity but weaker.

long_description.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyebut Poseidon sebagai penguasa laut yang menghimpun awan dan memanggil badai, tetapi juga dapat memberi pelayaran yang berhasil dan menyelamatkan orang yang dalam bahaya. Menurut Wikipedia, bila ia tersinggung atau diabaikan, konon ia menghantam tanah dengan trisulanya sehingga timbul gempa, orang tenggelam, dan kapal karam. Istananya, menurut entri itu, berada di kedalaman laut dekat Aegae di Euboea, dan kudanya menarik keretanya di atas ombak; ia dianggap pencipta kuda serta pelindung pacuan kuda.
long_description.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi presents Poseidon as ruler of the sea who gathers clouds and calls forth storms, but who can also grant a successful voyage and save those in danger. According to Wikipedia, if he was slighted or neglected he was said to strike the earth with his trident, bringing earthquakes, drownings, and shipwrecks. His palace, according to that entry, was in the depth of the sea near Aegae in Euboea, and his fish-tailed horses drew his chariot; he was regarded as the creator of the horse and the protector of horse races.

long_description.id: Poseidon tampil dalam banyak kisah: ia bertanding melawan Athena untuk menguasai Athena, membantu membangun tembok Troya lalu mengirim monster laut ketika Raja Laomedon menolak membayar, dan menimpa Polybotes dengan pulau Kos. Dalam Odyssey, ia mengutuk Odiseus mengembara di laut sepuluh tahun karena putranya Polyphemus dibutakan. Ia menikahi Amphitrite, dan putra mereka adalah Triton; ia juga disebut ayah Theseus, Pegasos, Arion, dan Polyphemos.
long_description.en: Poseidon features in many stories: he contests Athens with Athena, helps build the walls of Troy and then sends a sea-monster when King Laomedon refuses to pay, and crushes Polybotes beneath the island of Kos. In the Odyssey he curses Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years because his son Polyphemus was blinded. He married Amphitrite, and their son was Triton; he is also named as father of Theseus, Pegasos, Arion, and Polyphemos.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Poseidon berasal dari akhir Zaman Perunggu dan peradaban Mycenae, dan Pylos menjadikannya dewa utama. Pesta Isthmia dekat Korintus diadakan untuk menghormatinya, dan kuil abad ke-5 SM-nya masih berdiri di Sounion. Dalam seni ia paling sering digambarkan dewasa dan berjanggut dengan trisula. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa kurban untuknya pada umumnya berupa banteng hitam dan putih, dan pacuan kuda serta kereta diadakan untuk menghormatinya di tanah genting Korintus, sedangkan World History Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa para pelaut dan nelayan di mana-mana memberi persembahan nazar kepadanya demi perlindungan. Menurut Wikipedia, Poseidon masih dipuja hingga kini dalam agama Helenik modern.
long_description.en: Worship of Poseidon dates to the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization, and Pylos had him as its main god. The Isthmian games near Corinth were held in his honour, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands at Sounion. In art he is most often shown mature and bearded with a trident. According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, he was usually offered black and white bulls, and the Corinthian isthmus hosted horse and chariot races for him; World History Encyclopedia adds that mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to him for protection. According to Wikipedia, Poseidon is still worshipped today in modern Hellenic religion.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Himne Homerik menyebut sifat ganda Poseidon sebagai dewa Olimpus: penjinak kuda dan penyelamat kapal; menurut World History Encyclopedia, para pelaut dan nelayan di mana-mana memberi persembahan nazar kepadanya demi perlindungan.
cultural_context.en: According to Wikipedia, the Homeric Hymn gives him a double office among the Olympians, tamer of horses and saviour of ships; according to World History Encyclopedia, mariners and fishermen everywhere made votive offerings to him for protection.

claims.quote: During the War of the Titanes, the Kyklopes (Cyclopes) crafted a magical trident for Poseidon, and together with his brothers Zeus and Haides he defeated the elder gods and imprisoned them in Tartaros.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, dalam Perang Titan, para Kiklops membuat trisula ajaib bagi Poseidon, dan bersama saudara-saudaranya Zeus dan Haides ia mengalahkan dewa-dewa yang lebih tua serta memenjarakan mereka di Tartaros.
statement.en: According to Theoi, during the War of the Titanes the Kyklopes crafted a magical trident for Poseidon, and with his brothers Zeus and Haides he defeated the elder gods and imprisoned them in Tartaros.

claims.quote: At birth Poseidon was swallowed whole by his father Kronos (Cronus), but Zeus later enlisted the aid of the goddess Metis who fed the Titan a magical elixir causing him to disgorge the god.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, saat lahir Poseidon ditelan bulat-bulat oleh ayahnya Kronos, tetapi Zeus kemudian meminta bantuan dewi Metis yang memberi sang Titan ramuan ajaib sehingga ia memuntahkan sang dewa.
statement.en: According to Theoi, at birth Poseidon was swallowed whole by his father Kronos, but Zeus later enlisted the goddess Metis, who fed the Titan a magical elixir causing him to disgorge the god.

claims.quote: In the earliest poems, Poseidon is described as indeed equal to Zeus in dignity, but weaker.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa dalam puisi-puisi paling awal Poseidon digambarkan setara dengan Zeus dalam martabat, tetapi lebih lemah.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says that in the earliest poems Poseidon is described as equal to Zeus in dignity, but weaker.

statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that Herodotus states the name and worship of Poseidon was imported to the Greeks from Libya, but that he was probably a divinity of Pelasgian origin.

claims.quote: Cults to Poseidon date as far back as the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization (at its peak from the 15th to 12th century BCE), as attested by Linear B inscriptions found at Pylos in the Peloponnese and Knossos on Crete.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pemujaan Poseidon berasal dari akhir Zaman Perunggu dan peradaban Mycenae (puncaknya abad ke-15 hingga ke-12 SM), dibuktikan oleh prasasti Linear B yang ditemukan di Pylos dan Knossos.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, cults to Poseidon date back to the late Bronze Age and the Mycenaean civilization (at its peak from the 15th to 12th century BCE), as attested by Linear B inscriptions found at Pylos and Knossos.

claims.quote: Pylos, we know, had Poseidon as its main god with a priestess as the head of his cult.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Pylos menjadikan Poseidon dewa utamanya dengan seorang pendeta perempuan sebagai kepala pemujaannya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Pylos had Poseidon as its main god with a priestess as the head of his cult.

claims.quote: Seemingly not content with the seas alone, Poseidon often interfered in the plans of Zeus, and once even attempted to overthrow his brother with the aid of Hera and Athena. It was as punishment for this treachery that Poseidon was made to build the magnificent walls of Troy.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon sering ikut campur dalam rencana Zeus dan pernah mencoba menggulingkannya dengan bantuan Hera dan Athena; sebagai hukuman atas pengkhianatan itu ia diwajibkan membangun tembok Troya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon often interfered in the plans of Zeus and once attempted to overthrow his brother with the aid of Hera and Athena; as punishment for this treachery he was made to build the walls of Troy.

claims.quote: Poseidon is most often described by both Homer and Hesiod as 'deep sounding Earth-shaker', the 'dark-haired one' and 'encircler of the earth.'

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Homeros dan Hesiodos paling sering menyebut Poseidon sebagai 'Penggoyang Bumi yang bergemuruh', 'si berambut gelap', dan 'pelingkar bumi'.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Homer and Hesiod most often describe Poseidon as 'deep sounding Earth-shaker', the 'dark-haired one' and 'encircler of the earth'.

claims.quote: In revenge for the blinding of his son Polyphemus, he cursed Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, sebagai balas dendam atas dibutakannya putranya Polyphemus, Poseidon mengutuk Odiseus mengembara di laut selama sepuluh tahun.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in revenge for the blinding of his son Polyphemus, Poseidon cursed Odysseus to wander the sea for ten years.

claims.quote: The god was particularly revered here and was the focus of horse races and other events at the Panhellenic Isthmian games which were held in his honour near Corinth.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon sangat dihormati di Tanah Genting Korintus dan menjadi pusat pacuan kuda serta acara lain pada Pesta Isthmia Panhelenik yang diadakan untuk menghormatinya dekat Korintus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon was particularly revered at the Isthmus of Corinth and was the focus of horse races and other events at the Panhellenic Isthmian games held in his honour near Corinth.

claims.quote: Sounion was another strategic site close to the god, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands on the promontory which overlooks ships entering the Saronic gulf.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Sounion adalah situs strategis yang dekat dengan sang dewa, dan kuil abad ke-5 SM-nya masih berdiri di tanjung yang menghadap kapal-kapal yang memasuki Teluk Saronik.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Sounion was another strategic site close to the god, and his 5th-century BCE temple still stands on the promontory overlooking ships entering the Saronic gulf.

claims.quote: In the legendary competition with Athena to win the patronage of Athens, Poseidon offered to the city the gifts of a saltwater spring and a horse. However, Athena's gift of an olive tree gained greater favour

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam pertandingan legendaris melawan Athena untuk menjadi pelindung Athena, Poseidon menawarkan mata air asin dan seekor kuda, tetapi hadiah pohon zaitun dari Athena lebih disukai.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the legendary competition with Athena for the patronage of Athens, Poseidon offered a saltwater spring and a horse, but Athena's gift of an olive tree gained greater favour.

claims.quote: Poseidon is most commonly depicted in ancient Greek art as mature and bearded. He often brandishes his trident, fashioned by the Cyclopes, with which he would create earthquakes by striking it to the ground.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Yunani kuno Poseidon paling sering digambarkan dewasa dan berjanggut, sering mengacungkan trisula buatan para Kiklops yang ia pakai menciptakan gempa dengan menghantamkannya ke tanah.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in ancient Greek art Poseidon is most commonly depicted as mature and bearded, often brandishing his trident, fashioned by the Cyclopes, with which he would create earthquakes by striking it to the ground.

claims.quote: Poseidon was himself responsible for another terrible creature - the Minotaur. Minos' failure to sacrifice the bull given as a gift by the god resulted in Poseidon bewitching Minos' wife Pasiphae into falling in love with the bull

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon bertanggung jawab atas Minotaur: karena Minos tidak mengurbankan banteng pemberian sang dewa, Poseidon menyihir istri Minos, Pasiphae, hingga jatuh cinta pada banteng itu.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Poseidon was responsible for the Minotaur: Minos' failure to sacrifice the bull given by the god resulted in Poseidon bewitching Minos' wife Pasiphae into falling in love with the bull.

claims.quote: three brethren are we, begotten of Cronos, and born of Rhea,—Zeus, and myself, and the third is Hades ... claims.quote: In his benign aspect, Poseidon was seen as creating new islands and offering calm seas. When offended or ignored, he supposedly struck the ground with his trident and caused chaotic springs, earthquakes, drownings and shipwrecks.

short_description.id: Artemis adalah dewi perburuan, alam liar, dan hewan dalam agama Yunani kuno, sekaligus pelindung anak perempuan dan perempuan yang melahirkan.
short_description.en: Artemis is a goddess of hunting, wilderness, and animals in ancient Greek religion, and a protector of girls and of women in childbirth.

long_description.id: Dalam agama Yunani kuno, Artemis membawahi perburuan, alam liar, hewan, dan kelahiran anak. Ia putri Leto dan Zeus serta saudara kembar Apollo, dan kerap dikisahkan berkeliaran di hutan dan gunung bersama para nimfa. Tempat kelahirannya disebut Delos atau Ortygia, dan sebagian tradisi bahkan menyebut orang tua yang berbeda.
long_description.en: In ancient Greek religion Artemis presides over hunting, wilderness, animals, and childbirth. She is the daughter of Leto and Zeus and twin sister of Apollo, and is often said to roam forests and mountains with nymphs. Her birthplace is given as Delos or Ortygia, and some traditions even name different parents.

long_description.id: Atribut Artemis yang paling khas adalah busur dan anak panah, dan hewan sucinya adalah rusa. Seni Yunani kuno paling sering menggambarkannya sebagai gadis pemburu dengan tabung panah dan busur atau tombak. Penggambaran awal menampilkannya sebagai dewi hewan, bersayap dan memegang hewan di kedua tangan.
long_description.en: Artemis's most distinctive attributes are her bow and arrows, and the deer is her sacred animal. Ancient Greek art most often shows her as a maiden huntress with quiver and bow or a spear. Early representations present her as a goddess of animals, winged and holding an animal in each hand.

long_description.id: Artemis dipandang sebagai pelindung anak dan perempuan yang melahirkan, tetapi juga sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit bagi perempuan dan anak perempuan. Ia dapat pula menyembuhkan, seperti saat menyembuhkan Aeneas. Dalam himne klasik ia melepaskan anak panah di pegunungan, dan bagi orang yang ia pandang dengan ramah ladang dan ternak berkembang.
long_description.en: Artemis is regarded as a protector of children and of women in childbirth, yet also as a bringer of sudden death and disease to women and girls. She can also heal, as when she heals Aeneas. In classical hymns she sends her arrows over the mountains, and for those she regards graciously the fields and livestock prosper.

long_description.id: Kisah-kisah Artemis menampilkan sisi pelindung dan sisi murkanya. Karena ia murka, armada Akhaia terhenti hingga Iphigenia hendak dikorbankan, lalu ia menggantinya dengan seekor rusa. Pemburu Actaion diubahnya menjadi rusa jantan dan dicabik anjingnya sendiri, dan para putri Niobe dibunuh dengan busurnya.
long_description.en: Stories of Artemis show both her protective and her wrathful sides. In her anger the Achaean fleet is held back until Iphigenia is about to be sacrificed, and she then substitutes a deer. The hunter Actaion is turned into a stag and torn apart by his own dogs, and Niobe's daughters are killed by her bow.

long_description.id: Kuil Artemis di Ephesus mulai dibangun sekitar 550 SM dan dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno. Pemujaannya juga ada di Brauron, tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis muda diselenggarakan, dan di Sparta serta Athena ia dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera. Di Ephesus pemujaannya memuat unsur dari timur dan satu sumber ensiklopedis menganggap Artemis Ephesus berbeda dari dewi Yunani.
long_description.en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus, begun around 550 BCE, ranked among the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Her cult was also found at Brauron, where rites of passage for young girls were held, and at Sparta and Athens she was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera. At Ephesus her cult included eastern elements, and one scholarly source considers the Ephesian Artemis distinct from the Greek goddess.

cultural_context.id: Sumber menyebut Artemis dipuja sebagai pelindung anak perempuan dan perempuan muda serta penolong saat melahirkan, dan di Brauron ia menjadi pusat ritus peralihan bagi gadis dan calon pengantin.
cultural_context.en: Sources describe Artemis as worshipped as a patron of girls and young women and as a helper in childbirth, and at Brauron she was the focus of rites of passage for girls and brides-to-be.

did_you_know.en: In the account recorded by World History Encyclopedia, the young Artemis asks her father for eternal virginity, as many names as Apollo, and a bow and arrow.

name.en: Huntress and mistress of wild animals

description.id: Sumber menyebut kekuatan khususnya mencakup menjadi pemburu luar biasa dan penguasa semua hewan liar.
description.en: A source says her special powers include being an extraordinary huntress and the mistress of all wild animals.

description.id: Bersama Apollon, ia dipandang sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit, dengan sasaran perempuan dan anak perempuan.
description.en: Together with Apollon she is seen as a bringer of sudden death and disease, targeting women and girls.

description.id: Ia menyembuhkan Aeneas yang terluka, dan satu sumber menyebutnya menyembuhkan serta meringankan penderitaan manusia.
description.en: She heals the wounded Aeneas, and one source says she cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.

description.id: Dalam kisah, ia mengubah Actaion menjadi rusa jantan dan Callisto menjadi beruang.
description.en: In stories she turns Actaion into a stag and Callisto into a bear.

description.id: Di Sparta dan di Athena (setelah Pertempuran Marathon) Artemis dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera dan dipandang sebagai dewi pertempuran.
description.en: At Sparta and at Athens (after the Battle of Marathon) Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle.

description.id: Di Ephesus ia dipuja sebagai dewi kesuburan dengan unsur dari timur, dan lebah, kurma, serta rusa jantan menjadi lambang utamanya. Satu sumber ensiklopedis menyebut Artemis Ephesus dewi yang sama sekali berbeda dari dewi Yunani.
description.en: At Ephesus she was revered as a fertility deity with eastern elements, and the bee, date palm, and stag were her principal symbols. One encyclopedic source calls the Ephesian Artemis a divinity totally distinct from the Greek goddess.

role.id: Dewi yang murka lalu menyelamatkan Iphigenia.
role.en: The angered goddess who then rescues Iphigenia.

summary.id: Agamemnon membuat Artemis murka dengan membunuh rusanya, sehingga armada Akhaia tidak bisa berlayar. Setelah Iphigenia dikorbankan, Artemis menggantinya dengan rusa dan menjadikannya pendeta di Tauris.
summary.en: Agamemnon angers Artemis by killing her deer, and the Achaean fleet cannot sail. When Iphigenia is offered in sacrifice, Artemis substitutes a deer and makes her a priestess at Tauris.

role.id: Dewi yang mengubah pemburu menjadi rusa jantan.
role.en: The goddess who turns a hunter into a stag.

summary.id: Actaion diubah menjadi rusa jantan lalu dicabik anjing-anjingnya sendiri; sebabnya adalah bualannya sebagai pemburu atau, dalam versi lain, karena ia mengintip Artemis mandi.
summary.en: Actaion is turned into a stag and torn apart by his own dogs, for boasting as a hunter or, in another version, for spying on Artemis bathing.

role.id: Dewi yang mengubah pengiringnya menjadi beruang.
role.en: The goddess who turns her attendant into a bear.

summary.id: Callisto, dayang sang dewi yang dirayu Zeus, diubah Artemis menjadi beruang dan diasingkan; Zeus kemudian menjadikan Callisto dan putranya Arcas rasi beruang besar dan kecil.
summary.en: Callisto, the goddess's handmaiden whom Zeus seduced, is turned into a bear and exiled by Artemis; Zeus later turns Callisto and her son Arcas into the great and little bear constellations.

role.id: Dewi yang membunuh, atau tertipu membunuh, Orion.
role.en: The goddess who kills, or is tricked into killing, Orion.

summary.id: World History Encyclopedia menyebut Artemis membunuh Orion setelah percobaan pemerkosaan, sedangkan Theoi menyebut Apollon menipunya hingga ia membunuh Orion dan ia lalu menempatkan Orion di antara bintang.
summary.en: World History Encyclopedia says Artemis kills Orion after an attempted rape, while Theoi says Apollon tricks her into killing him and she places him among the stars.

role.id: Dewi yang mengirim babi hutan sebagai hukuman.
role.en: The goddess who sends a boar as punishment.

summary.id: Artemis mengirim babi hutan raksasa untuk merusak Kalydon setelah kota itu lalai berkurban kepadanya.
summary.en: Artemis sends a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city neglects to sacrifice to her.

role.id: Dewi yang membunuh dengan busurnya.
role.en: The goddess who kills with her bow.

summary.id: Setelah Niobe membual melampaui Leto, Artemis membunuh putri-putrinya dengan busur.
summary.en: After Niobe boasts of surpassing Leto, Artemis kills her daughters with her bow.

role.id: Dewi yang berwujud rusa betina untuk memperdaya raksasa.
role.en: The goddess who takes the form of a doe to trick the giants.

summary.id: Saat Aloadai mencoba menyerbu Olimpos, Artemis berwujud rusa betina dan berlari di antara mereka sehingga mereka saling membunuh.
summary.en: When the Aloadai try to storm Olympos, Artemis takes the form of a doe and runs between them so that they strike each other dead.

description.id: Kota tempat Kuil Artemis dibangun mulai sekitar 550 SM, yang dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
description.en: City of the Temple of Artemis, begun c. 550 BCE and regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

description.id: Situs kuil dan mata air suci di pantai timur Attika, tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis dan calon pengantin.
description.en: Temple site and sacred spring on the east coast of Attica, host to rites of passage for girls and brides-to-be.

description.id: Pulau tempat Artemis lahir dalam sebagian versi mitos dan tempat ia membantu kelahiran Apollo.
description.en: Island where Artemis was born in some versions of the myth and where she assisted the birth of Apollo.

description.id: Lokasi tempat suci Artemis tempat Iphigenia dijadikan pendeta.
description.en: Location of the Artemis sanctuary where Iphigenia was made a priestess.

title.en: Earliest attested forms of the name

description.id: Bentuk nama Artemis yang paling awal terbukti ditulis dalam Linear B di Pylos.
description.en: The earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are written in Linear B at Pylos.

description.id: Gagang Vas Francois menampilkan Artemis memegang macan tutul dan rusa jantan serta singa.
description.en: The handles of the Francois vase show Artemis holding a panther and stag and lions.

title.en: Temple of Artemis at Ephesus begun

description.id: Pembangunan kuil dimulai sekitar 550 SM dan selesai setelah kerja selama seabad.
description.en: Construction of the temple began around 550 BCE and finished after a century of labour.

description.id: Setelah Pertempuran Marathon tahun 490 SM, Athena memuja Artemis sebagai Artemis Agrotera.
description.en: After the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE, Athens worshipped Artemis as Artemis Agrotera.

note.id: Saudara kembar Artemis.
note.en: Artemis's twin brother.

note.id: Ibu Artemis.
note.en: Artemis's mother.

note.id: Ayah Artemis.
note.en: Artemis's father.

note.id: Padanan Artemis dalam tradisi Romawi.
note.en: Artemis's Roman equivalent.

note.id: Dalam satu kisah, Hera merebut busur Artemis dan memukulinya.
note.en: In one story Hera tears Artemis's bow away and beats her.

note.id: Pemburu yang dalam kisah-kisah dibunuh Artemis.
note.en: The hunter whom Artemis kills in the stories.

note.id: Pengiring Artemis yang diubah menjadi beruang.
note.en: Artemis's attendant who is turned into a bear.

note.id: Gadis yang diselamatkan Artemis dari pengorbanan dan dijadikan pendeta.
note.en: The girl Artemis saves from sacrifice and makes a priestess.

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana peran Artemis dalam perburuan dan kelahiran anak ditampilkan dalam sumber?
learning_questions.en: How do the sources present Artemis's roles in hunting and childbirth?

learning_questions.id: Mengapa sumber-sumber berbeda mengenai kematian Orion?
learning_questions.en: Why might sources differ about the death of Orion?

learning_questions.id: Apa yang dapat dipelajari dari perbedaan antara Artemis di Ephesus dan Artemis Yunani lainnya?
learning_questions.en: What can be learned from the difference between the Ephesian Artemis and other Greek Artemis traditions?

claims.quote: is the goddess of hunting, the wilderness, wild animals, transitions, nature, vegetation, childbirth, care of children, and chastity.

statement.id: Artemis adalah dewi Yunani kuno yang membawahi perburuan, alam liar, hewan, dan kelahiran anak.
statement.en: Artemis is an ancient Greek goddess of hunting, wilderness, animals, and childbirth.

claims.quote: Artemis was the daughter of Leto and Zeus, and twin sister of Apollo.

statement.id: Artemis adalah putri Leto dan Zeus serta saudara kembar Apollo.
statement.en: Artemis is Leto and Zeus's daughter and Apollo's twin.

claims.quote: She was often said to roam the forests and mountains, attended by an entourage of nymphs.

statement.id: Artemis sering dikisahkan berkeliaran di hutan dan gunung bersama para nimfa.
statement.en: Artemis was said to roam forests and mountains with nymphs.

claims.quote: The goddess Diana is her Roman equivalent.

statement.id: Padanan Artemis dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Diana.
statement.en: Artemis's Roman counterpart is Diana.

claims.quote: In ancient art Artemis was usually depicted as a girl or young maiden with a hunting bow and quiver of arrows.

statement.id: Dalam seni kuno Artemis lazim digambarkan sebagai gadis atau perempuan muda dengan busur dan tabung anak panah.
statement.en: Ancient art commonly shows Artemis as a girl or young woman with a hunting bow and quiver.

claims.quote: Daughter of Zeus and sister of Apollo, Artemis was a patron of girls and young women, and a protectress during childbirth. Artemis was widely worshipped but her most famous cult site was the Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

statement.id: Artemis menjadi pelindung gadis, perempuan muda, dan perempuan yang melahirkan; situs pemujaannya yang terkenal adalah Kuil Artemis di Ephesus, salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
statement.en: Artemis protected girls, young women, and women in childbirth; her famous temple at Ephesus was one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.quote: The king had displeased the goddess by killing one of her deer in a sacred grove. As punishment, Artemis becalmed the Achaean fleet and only the sacrifice of Iphigenia would appease the goddess into granting a fair wind to Troy.

statement.id: Raja Agamemnon membuat Artemis murka karena membunuh seekor rusa di hutan suci; sebagai hukuman Artemis membuat armada Akhaia terjebak tanpa angin, dan hanya pengorbanan Iphigenia yang akan menenangkannya.
statement.en: King Agamemnon displeased Artemis by killing one of her deer in a sacred grove; as punishment she becalmed the Achaean fleet, and only the sacrifice of Iphigenia would appease her.

claims.quote: Agamemnon duly offered his daughter in sacrifice, but in pity and at the last moment, the goddess substituted a deer for the girl and made Iphigenia a priestess at her sanctuary at Tauris.

statement.id: Agamemnon mengorbankan putrinya, tetapi pada saat terakhir sang dewi menggantinya dengan seekor rusa dan menjadikan Iphigenia pendeta di tempat sucinya di Tauris.
statement.en: Agamemnon offered his daughter, but at the last moment the goddess substituted a deer and made Iphigenia a priestess at her sanctuary at Tauris.

claims.quote: The goddess is said to have killed the hunter Orion after his attempted rape of either Artemis herself or one of her followers.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Artemis dikatakan membunuh pemburu Orion setelah Orion berusaha memperkosa Artemis sendiri atau salah satu pengikutnya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis is said to have killed the hunter Orion after his attempted rape of either Artemis herself or one of her followers.

claims.quote: The handsome giant Orion was a companion of the goddess but her jealous brother Apollon tricked her into killing him with a distant bow-shot. In her grief Artemis placed him amongst the stars as the constellation Orion.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, Orion adalah sahabat sang dewi; Apollon yang cemburu memperdayainya hingga ia membunuh Orion dengan anak panah dari jauh, lalu Artemis menempatkan Orion di antara bintang sebagai rasi Orion.
statement.en: According to Theoi, Orion was the goddess's companion; her jealous brother Apollon tricked her into killing him with a distant bow-shot, and in grief Artemis placed him among the stars as the constellation Orion.

claims.quote: Artemis turned Callisto, one of the goddess' entourage, into a bear after she had lain with Zeus, who then turned her and her son Arcas into the constellations the great and little bear

statement.id: Artemis mengubah Callisto, salah satu pengiringnya, menjadi beruang setelah Callisto tidur dengan Zeus; Zeus kemudian mengubah Callisto dan putranya Arcas menjadi rasi beruang besar dan beruang kecil.
statement.en: Artemis turned Callisto, one of her entourage, into a bear after she lay with Zeus, who then turned her and her son Arcas into the constellations of the great and little bear.

claims.quote: The hunter Actaion, after he dared boast he was the greater hunter or, in another version, had spied on Artemis while she had bathed in a forest pool, was turned into a stag by the goddess. Actaion was then torn to pieces by his own pack of 50 hunting dogs.

statement.id: Pemburu Actaion diubah Artemis menjadi rusa jantan, entah karena berani membual bahwa ia pemburu yang lebih hebat, entah (dalam versi lain) karena mengintip Artemis mandi di kolam hutan; ia lalu dicabik oleh 50 anjing pemburunya sendiri.
statement.en: The hunter Actaion was turned into a stag by Artemis, either for boasting he was the greater hunter or (in another version) for spying on her bathing in a forest pool; he was then torn apart by his own 50 hunting dogs.

claims.quote: The goddess uses her bow to mercilessly kill the six (or in some accounts seven) daughters of Niobe following her boast that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

statement.id: Artemis memakai busurnya untuk membunuh enam (dalam sebagian kisah tujuh) putri Niobe setelah Niobe membual bahwa kemampuannya melahirkan lebih besar daripada Leto.
statement.en: Artemis uses her bow to kill the six (or in some accounts seven) daughters of Niobe after Niobe boasted that her childbearing capacity was greater than Leto's.

claims.quote: Finally, Artemis sent a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city had neglected to sacrifice to the goddess.

statement.id: Artemis mengirim babi hutan raksasa untuk merusak Kalydon setelah kota itu lalai mempersembahkan kurban kepadanya.
statement.en: Artemis sent a huge boar to ravage Kalydon after the city neglected to sacrifice to her.

claims.quote: When the Aloadai (Aloadae) giants tried to storm Olympos, Artemis assumed the form of a doe and raced between them causing the pair to cast their spears, miss, and strike each other dead.

statement.id: Ketika raksasa Aloadai mencoba menyerbu Olimpos, Artemis berwujud rusa betina dan berlari di antara mereka sehingga keduanya melempar tombak, meleset, dan saling membunuh.
statement.en: When the Aloadai giants tried to storm Olympos, Artemis took the form of a doe and ran between them, so that the pair cast their spears, missed, and struck each other dead.

claims.quote: Artemis was a divine ally of the Trojans during the Trojan War. In a clash between the rival factions of gods she confronted Hera, but the Queen of the Gods tore the bow from her hands, beat her about the head, and sent her fleeing back to Olympos in tears.

statement.id: Artemis menjadi sekutu ilahi bangsa Troya dalam Perang Troya; dalam bentrokan antarkubu dewa ia berhadapan dengan Hera, yang merebut busurnya, memukulinya, dan membuatnya lari menangis ke Olimpos.
statement.en: Artemis was a divine ally of the Trojans in the Trojan War; in a clash between rival factions of gods she confronted Hera, who tore the bow from her hands, beat her, and sent her fleeing to Olympos in tears.

claims.quote: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows but she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, pair of hunting spears, torch, lyre, and/or water-jug.

statement.id: Atribut Artemis yang paling khas adalah busur dan anak panah; ia kadang juga dilengkapi tabung panah, sepasang tombak berburu, obor, lira, dan/atau kendi air.
statement.en: Artemis' most distinctive attributes were her bow and arrows; she was also sometimes equipped with a quiver, a pair of hunting spears, a torch, a lyre, and/or a water-jug.

claims.quote: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer. She drove a chariot drawn by a pair of the beasts and was often depicted holding or hunting a deer or with a deer-skin cape draped over her shoulders.

statement.id: Hewan suci Artemis adalah rusa; ia mengendarai kereta yang ditarik sepasang rusa dan sering digambarkan memegang atau memburu rusa atau berjubah kulit rusa.
statement.en: Artemis' sacred animal was the deer; she drove a chariot drawn by a pair of deer and was often shown holding or hunting a deer or wearing a deer-skin cape.

claims.quote: Together the two gods were also bringers of sudden death and disease--Artemis targetted women and girls, Apollon men and boys.

statement.id: Artemis dan Apollon juga dipandang sebagai pembawa kematian mendadak dan penyakit; Artemis menyasar perempuan dan anak perempuan, Apollon laki-laki dan anak laki-laki.
statement.en: Artemis and Apollon were also bringers of sudden death and disease; Artemis targeted women and girls, Apollon men and boys.

claims.quote: Supporting the Trojans, she notably heals Aeneas after he is wounded by Diomedes.

statement.id: Dalam mendukung bangsa Troya, Artemis menyembuhkan Aeneas setelah Aeneas dilukai Diomedes.
statement.en: Supporting the Trojans, Artemis heals Aeneas after he is wounded by Diomedes.

claims.quote: Over the shadowy hills and windy peaks she draws her golden bow, rejoicing in the chase, and sends out grievous shafts.
claims.locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Homeric Hymn 27 to Artemis (trans. Evelyn-White)

statement.id: Himne Homerik 27 melukiskan Artemis menarik busur emasnya di bukit berbayang dan puncak berangin, bersuka dalam perburuan, dan melepaskan anak panah yang menyakitkan.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 27 describes Artemis drawing her golden bow over shadowy hills and windy peaks, rejoicing in the chase, and sending out grievous shafts.

claims.quote: But on whomsoever thou lookest smiling and gracious, for them the tilth bears the corn-ear abundantly, and abundantly prospers the four-footed breed, and abundant waxes their prosperity
claims.locator: Classical Literature Quotes, Callimachus Hymn 3 to Artemis (trans. Mair)

statement.id: Himne Kallimakhos kepada Artemis menyebut bahwa bagi orang yang dipandang Artemis dengan ramah, ladang berbuah melimpah, ternak berkaki empat berkembang, dan kemakmuran mereka bertambah.
statement.en: Callimachus's Hymn to Artemis says that for those on whom Artemis looks graciously, the tilled land bears corn abundantly, four-footed livestock prosper, and their prosperity grows.

claims.quote: The famous temple of Artemis at the city (begun c. 550 BCE) was almost twice the size of Athens' Parthenon when it was finally finished after a century of labour; it was regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

statement.id: Kuil Artemis yang termasyhur di Ephesus mulai dibangun sekitar 550 SM; ketika selesai setelah kerja selama seabad, ukurannya hampir dua kali Parthenon di Athena, dan dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
statement.en: The famous temple of Artemis at Ephesus was begun c. 550 BCE; finished after a century of labour, it was almost twice the size of Athens' Parthenon and regarded as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.quote: Other notable places of worship of Artemis were the sanctuaries at Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, and on the island of Delos, where the goddess was born in some myth versions and where she assisted the birth of her brother Apollo.

statement.id: Tempat pemujaan Artemis yang penting lainnya mencakup tempat suci di Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, dan pulau Delos, tempat ia lahir dalam sebagian versi mitos dan membantu kelahiran saudaranya Apollo.
statement.en: Other notable places of worship of Artemis were sanctuaries at Brauron, Tauris, Magnesia, Perge, and on the island of Delos, where she was born in some versions of the myth and assisted the birth of her brother Apollo.

claims.quote: At Brauron, on the east coast of Attica, a temple site and sacred spring was in use from the 8th to 3rd century BCE and hosted rites of passage for young girls and brides-to-be.

statement.id: Di Brauron, di pantai timur Attika, sebuah situs kuil dan mata air suci dipakai dari abad ke-8 hingga ke-3 SM dan menjadi tempat ritus peralihan bagi gadis muda dan calon pengantin.
statement.en: At Brauron, on the east coast of Attica, a temple site and sacred spring was in use from the 8th to 3rd century BCE and hosted rites of passage for young girls and brides-to-be.

claims.quote: Artemis is most frequently portrayed in ancient Greek art as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.
claims.locator: How is Artemis Represented in Art?

statement.id: Dalam seni Yunani kuno Artemis paling sering digambarkan sebagai gadis pemburu yang cantik dengan tabung panah dan busur, atau sebagai alternatif dengan tombak.
statement.en: In ancient Greek art Artemis is most frequently portrayed as a beautiful maiden huntress with quiver and bow or, alternatively, a spear.

claims.quote: Early representations also emphasise her role as goddess of animals and show her winged with a bird or animal in each hand. For example, on the handles of the celebrated Francois vase (570-565 BCE), she holds a panther and stag in one depiction and lions in another.
claims.locator: How is Artemis Represented in Art?

statement.id: Penggambaran awal menekankan peran Artemis sebagai dewi hewan dan menampilkannya bersayap dengan seekor burung atau hewan di tiap tangan; pada gagang Vas Francois (570-565 SM) ia memegang macan tutul dan rusa jantan di satu adegan dan singa di adegan lain.
statement.en: Early representations emphasise her role as goddess of animals and show her winged with a bird or animal in each hand; on the handles of the Francois vase (570-565 BCE) she holds a panther and stag in one depiction and lions in another.

claims.quote: Born either on Delos or Ortygia (near Ephesus in Western Turkey), she is the twin sister of the god Apollo.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Artemis lahir di Delos atau Ortygia (dekat Ephesus di Turki bagian barat) dan merupakan saudari kembar Apollo.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Artemis was born either on Delos or Ortygia (near Ephesus in Western Turkey) and is Apollo's twin sister.

claims.quote: Artemis was a daughter of Demeter, and not of Leto, while according to an Egyptian story (Herod. ii. 156) she was the daughter of Dionysus and Isis, and Leto was only her nurse.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology yang dikutip Theoi, satu tradisi menyebut Artemis putri Demeter, bukan Leto, dan menurut kisah Mesir ia putri Dionysus dan Isis, sedangkan Leto hanya pengasuhnya.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology reproduced on Theoi, one tradition made Artemis a daughter of Demeter rather than Leto, and an Egyptian story made her the daughter of Dionysus and Isis, with Leto only her nurse.

claims.quote: the earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are the Mycenaean Greek ... written in Linear B at Pylos.

statement.id: Bentuk nama Artemis yang paling awal terbukti adalah bentuk Yunani Mykenai yang ditulis dalam Linear B di Pylos.
statement.en: The earliest attested forms of the name Artemis are Mycenaean Greek, written in Linear B at Pylos.

claims.quote: The etymology of the name "Artemis" (n., f.) remains uncertain, though various origins have been proposed.

statement.id: Asal-usul nama "Artemis" masih belum pasti, meski berbagai asal telah diusulkan.
statement.en: The etymology of the name "Artemis" remains uncertain, though various origins have been proposed.

claims.quote: Artemis was a kourotrophic (child-nurturing) deity, being the protector of children, especially girls, and animal cubs. She was worshipped and feared as one of the primary goddesses of childbirth and midwifery along with Eileithyia and Hera.

statement.id: Artemis adalah dewi kourotrofik (pengasuh anak), pelindung anak-anak terutama anak perempuan serta anak hewan, dan dipuja serta ditakuti sebagai salah satu dewi utama persalinan dan kebidanan bersama Eileithyia dan Hera.
statement.en: Artemis was a kourotrophic (child-nurturing) deity, protector of children, especially girls, and animal cubs, and was worshipped and feared as one of the primary goddesses of childbirth and midwifery along with Eileithyia and Hera.

claims.quote: As Apollo was not only a destructive god, but also averted the evils which it was in his power to inflict, so Artemis was at the same time a thea ... that is, she cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.
claims.locator: Encyclopedia (Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology)

statement.id: Menurut Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, seperti Apollo yang tidak hanya merusak tetapi juga menangkal malapetaka, Artemis pada saat yang sama menyembuhkan dan meringankan penderitaan manusia.
statement.en: According to the Dictionary of Greek and Roman Biography and Mythology, just as Apollo not only destroyed but also averted evils, Artemis at the same time cured and alleviated the sufferings of mortals.

claims.quote: At Sparta and Athens (after the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE), Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle, a goat being sacrificed to her before an engagement by the Spartans

statement.id: Di Sparta dan Athena (setelah Pertempuran Marathon tahun 490 SM) Artemis dipuja sebagai Artemis Agrotera dan dipandang sebagai dewi pertempuran; orang Sparta mengorbankan seekor kambing kepadanya sebelum bertempur.
statement.en: At Sparta and Athens (after the Battle of Marathon of 490 BCE) Artemis was worshipped as Artemis Agrotera and regarded as a goddess of battle, the Spartans sacrificing a goat to her before an engagement.

claims.quote: As a deity of fertility, Artemis Ephesia was particularly revered at Ephesus, near to what many believed was her birthplace, Ortygia. Here, her cult included eastern elements (borrowed from goddesses such as Isis, Cybele, and the "Mistress of the Animals") and her principal symbols were the bee, date palm, and stag.

statement.id: Sebagai dewi kesuburan, Artemis Ephesia sangat dipuja di Ephesus; pemujaannya memuat unsur-unsur dari timur (dipinjam dari dewi seperti Isis, Kibele, dan "Nyonya Para Hewan") dengan lebah, kurma, dan rusa jantan sebagai lambang utama.
statement.en: As a deity of fertility, Artemis Ephesia was particularly revered at Ephesus; her cult included eastern elements (borrowed from goddesses such as Isis, Cybele, and the "Mistress of the Animals") and her principal symbols were the bee, date palm, and stag.

short_description.id: Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga dalam agama Yunani kuno, serta ratu para dewa Olimpus dan istri sekaligus saudari Zeus.
short_description.en: Hera is the goddess of marriage, women, and family in ancient Greek religion, queen of the Olympian gods, and the sister and wife of Zeus.

long_description.id: Hera adalah dewi perkawinan, perempuan, dan keluarga dalam agama Yunani kuno, dan dalam mitologi ia menjadi ratu di antara dua belas dewa Olimpus serta saudari dan istri Zeus. Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Hera adalah satu-satunya dewi Olimpus yang benar-benar menikah, sehingga ia dewi perkawinan dan kelahiran anak. Dalam seni ia digambarkan sebagai sosok berwibawa yang duduk di singgasana atau berdiri, bermahkota, memegang tongkat kerajaan atau delima, dan hewan sucinya mencakup sapi, burung kukuk, dan merak.
long_description.en: Hera is the goddess of marriage, women, and family in ancient Greek religion, and in myth she is queen among the twelve Olympians and the sister and wife of Zeus. According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, she was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, and hence goddess of marriage and of the birth of children. In art she appears as a dignified figure enthroned or standing, crowned, holding a royal sceptre or a pomegranate, and her sacred animals include the cow, cuckoo, and peacock.

long_description.id: Hera adalah putri Cronus dan Rhea, dan saudari Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, serta Zeus. Dalam Iliad 4 ia menyebut dirinya putri Cronus yang paling dihormati. Bersama Zeus ia menjadi ibu Ares, Hebe, dan Eileithyia. Menurut Theoi ia melahirkan Hephaistos seorang diri lalu melemparkannya dari surga karena lahir cacat, sedangkan World History Encyclopedia mencatat versi lain, bahwa Zeus yang melemparkannya karena kepincangannya.
long_description.en: Hera was born to Cronus and Rhea, and her siblings include Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus. In Iliad 4 she calls herself the most honoured of Cronos's daughters. With Zeus she is the mother of Ares, Hebe, and Eileithyia. According to Theoi she produced Hephaistos alone and cast him from heaven because he was born crippled, while World History Encyclopedia records another version in which Zeus threw him because of his lameness.

long_description.id: Mitos tentang Hera banyak berkisar pada perkawinannya dengan Zeus. Menurut Theoi, Zeus merayunya dengan menyamar sebagai burung kukuk. World History Encyclopedia menyebut Hera setia kepada Zeus tetapi terkenal cemburu dan pendendam terhadap kekasih suaminya dan anak-anak mereka. Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat wataknya menurut Homer ditandai cemburu, keras kepala, dan suka bertengkar, bahwa ia jauh lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan, dan bahkan pernah digantung Zeus di awan.
long_description.en: Myths about Hera revolve largely around her marriage to Zeus. According to Theoi, Zeus seduced her in the guise of a cuckoo. World History Encyclopedia says Hera was faithful to Zeus but famous for a jealous and vengeful nature aimed at her husband's lovers and their children. The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi notes that her character in Homer is marked by jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition, that she is far inferior to Zeus in power, and that he once even hung her up in the clouds.

long_description.id: Hera dikisahkan menghukum para kekasih Zeus dan anak-anak mereka: Leto, Semele, dan Alkmene dianiaya; Io menjadi sasaran seekor lalat pengganggu; dan Hercules ditimpa ular, kegilaan, serta dua belas pekerjaan. Ia juga membuat Tiresias buta, dan Ixion dihukum dengan roda berapi karena mencoba menodainya. Di sisi lain, ia membantu Jason dan para Argonaut, dan dalam perang Troya ia berpihak pada bangsa Akhaia karena dendam kepada Paris.
long_description.en: Hera is said to punish Zeus's lovers and their children: Leto, Semele, and Alkmene are persecuted; Io is pursued by a gadfly; and Hercules is beset by snakes, madness, and twelve labours. She also struck Tiresias blind, and Ixion was punished with a fiery wheel for trying to violate her. On the other side, she assisted Jason and the Argonauts, and in the Trojan War she sided with the Achaeans out of a grudge against Paris.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Hera berpusat di Argos, yang memiliki tempat suci untuknya sejak pertengahan abad ke-8 SM menurut World History Encyclopedia. Dalam Iliad, Hera menyebut Argos, Sparta, dan Mycenae sebagai tiga kota yang paling disayanginya. Ia juga dipuja di Olympia, Tiryns, dan Samos, dan di seluruh Yunani diadakan perlombaan perempuan Heraia serta festival pernikahan tahunan. Padanannya dalam tradisi Romawi adalah Juno.
long_description.en: Hera's cult centred on Argos, which had a sanctuary for her from the mid-8th century BCE according to World History Encyclopedia. In the Iliad, Hera names Argos, Sparta, and Mycenae as the three cities dearest to her. She was also worshipped at Olympia, Tiryns, and Samos, and across Greece the women's competitions called Heraia and annual marriage festivals were held. Her Roman counterpart is Juno.

cultural_context.en: According to Theoi, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, hence goddess of marriage and childbirth; World History Encyclopedia records that her cult included the women's sporting competitions called Heraia and annual marriage festivals in which couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

statement.en: According to Theoi, Hera produced Hephaistos (Hephaestus) alone without a father and cast him from heaven because he was born crippled.

claims.quote: The judgement of Paris, in which she competed against Aphrodite and Athene for the prize of the golden apple.

statement.id: Menurut Theoi, dalam penghakiman Paris, Hera bersaing melawan Aphrodite dan Athene untuk memperebutkan apel emas.
statement.en: According to Theoi, in the judgement of Paris Hera competed against Aphrodite and Athene for the prize of the golden apple.

claims.quote: Properly speaking, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians ... and hence she is the goddess of marriage and of the birth of children.

statement.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, Hera adalah satu-satunya dewi Olimpus yang benar-benar menikah, sehingga ia dewi perkawinan dan kelahiran anak.
statement.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, Hera was the only really married goddess among the Olympians, and hence she is the goddess of marriage and of the birth of children.

claims.quote: Her character, as described by Homer, is not of a very amiable kind, and its main features are jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa watak Hera menurut Homer tidak terlalu ramah, dengan ciri utama cemburu, keras kepala, dan suka bertengkar.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera's character, as described by Homer, is not very amiable, its main features being jealousy, obstinacy, and a quarrelling disposition.

claims.quote: Zeus, in such cases, not only threatens, but beats her; and once he even hung her up in the clouds, her hands chained, and with two anvils suspended from her feet

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi mencatat bahwa dalam perselisihan Zeus tidak hanya mengancam tetapi memukul Hera, dan pernah menggantungnya di awan dengan tangan dirantai dan dua landasan di kakinya.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi records that Zeus not only threatens but beats her, and once hung her up in the clouds, her hands chained and two anvils suspended from her feet.

claims.quote: There is only one point in which the Homeric poems represent Hera as possessed of similar power with Zeus, viz. she is able to confer the power of prophecy

statement.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, satu-satunya hal yang membuat puisi Homeros menampilkan Hera sama berkuasa dengan Zeus ialah kemampuannya menganugerahkan kuasa nubuat.
statement.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the one point in which the Homeric poems show Hera with power similar to Zeus is that she is able to confer the power of prophecy.

claims.quote: According to tradition, Hera had disputed the possession of Argos with Poseidon, but the river-gods of the country adjudicated it to her.

statement.id: Menurut tradisi yang dimuat Theoi, Hera pernah bersengketa dengan Poseidon atas Argos, tetapi dewa-dewa sungai negeri itu memutuskan Argos untuknya.
statement.en: According to a tradition reproduced by Theoi, Hera had disputed the possession of Argos with Poseidon, but the river-gods of the country adjudicated it to her.

claims.quote: Her most celebrated sanctuary was situated between Argos and Mycenae, at the foot of Mount Euboea.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa tempat suci Hera yang paling termasyhur terletak di antara Argos dan Mycenae, di kaki Gunung Euboea.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera's most celebrated sanctuary was situated between Argos and Mycenae, at the foot of Mount Euboea.

claims.quote: The sitting colossal statue of Hera in this temple, made of gold and ivory, was the work of Polycletus.

statement.id: Menurut entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi, arca Hera yang duduk dan kolosal di kuil itu dibuat dari emas dan gading oleh Polycletus.
statement.en: According to the dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi, the sitting colossal statue of Hera in this temple, made of gold and ivory, was the work of Polycletus.

claims.quote: I sing of golden-throned Hera whom Rhea bare. Queen of the Immortals is she, surpassing all in beauty: she is the sister and wife of loud-thundering Zeus

statement.id: Himne Homerik 12 (terjemahan Evelyn-White) menyanyikan Hera yang bertakhta emas, yang dilahirkan Rhea, ratu para makhluk abadi, melampaui semua dalam keindahan, saudari dan istri Zeus yang menggelegar.
statement.en: Homeric Hymn 12 (Evelyn-White translation) sings of golden-throned Hera whom Rhea bare, queen of the Immortals, surpassing all in beauty, sister and wife of loud-thundering Zeus.

claims.quote: Hera was the daughter of Cronus and Rhea, and mother of Ares (god of war), Hebe (goddess of youth), and Eileithyia (goddess of childbirth), all with Zeus.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera adalah putri Cronus dan Rhea, dan ibu Ares (dewa perang), Hebe (dewi masa muda), dan Eileithyia (dewi persalinan), semuanya bersama Zeus.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera was the daughter of Cronus and Rhea, and mother of Ares (god of war), Hebe (goddess of youth), and Eileithyia (goddess of childbirth), all with Zeus.

claims.quote: However, Hera threw Hephaistos from Mount Olympus because of his ugliness, and crashing to earth, the god became lame. In other accounts, Hephaistos was thrown from the heavens by Zeus precisely because of his lameness.

statement.id: World History Encyclopedia mencatat bahwa Hera melemparkan Hephaistos dari Gunung Olympus karena keburukan rupanya sehingga ia menjadi pincang; menurut kisah lain, Zeus melemparkannya dari surga justru karena kepincangannya.
statement.en: World History Encyclopedia records that Hera threw Hephaistos from Mount Olympus because of his ugliness, so that he became lame; in other accounts Zeus threw him from the heavens precisely because of his lameness.

claims.quote: In memory, Hera then set his 100 eyes on the wings of a bird - the peacock.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam kisah Io, Hera kemudian menempatkan seratus mata Argos pada sayap seekor burung, yaitu merak.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the story of Io Hera then set Argos's 100 eyes on the wings of a bird, the peacock.

claims.quote: Finally, not to be outdone, the Greek goddess sent a gadfly to continually pester the unfortunate Io.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera mengirim seekor lalat pengganggu untuk terus menyiksa Io yang malang.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera sent a gadfly to continually pester the unfortunate Io.

claims.quote: Hera delayed his birth so that his cousin Eurystheus could claim the throne of Tiryns, sent two snakes to kill the infant while he slept, caused the hero to become mad and kill his own wife and children, and had Eurystheus set the hero his twelve labours

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera menunda kelahiran Hercules agar sepupunya Eurystheus dapat merebut takhta Tiryns, mengirim dua ular untuk membunuh bayi itu, membuatnya gila hingga membunuh istri dan anak-anaknya, dan membuat Eurystheus menugaskan dua belas pekerjaan kepadanya.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera delayed Hercules's birth so his cousin Eurystheus could claim the throne of Tiryns, sent two snakes to kill the infant, caused him to go mad and kill his own wife and children, and had Eurystheus set him his twelve labours.

claims.quote: The goddess supports the Achaeans and frequently schemes with other deities to bring the downfall of Troy, as she never forgave the Trojan prince Paris for choosing Aphrodite above her as the most beautiful goddess.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam Iliad Hera mendukung bangsa Akhaia dan sering bersekongkol dengan dewa lain demi runtuhnya Troya, karena ia tidak pernah memaafkan pangeran Paris yang memilih Aphrodite sebagai dewi tercantik.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in the Iliad Hera supports the Achaeans and frequently schemes with other deities to bring down Troy, as she never forgave the Trojan prince Paris for choosing Aphrodite as the most beautiful goddess.

claims.quote: She also had a temple dedicated to her at Olympia (650-600 BCE), and Tiryns was an important cult centre to the goddess in the 7th century BCE.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Hera memiliki kuil di Olympia (650-600 SM), dan Tiryns menjadi pusat pemujaan penting baginya pada abad ke-7 SM.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Hera had a temple at Olympia (650-600 BCE), and Tiryns was an important cult centre to the goddess in the 7th century BCE.

claims.quote: The island of Samos, in some accounts the birthplace of the goddess, had been a centre for cult worship of the Greek goddess as far back as the Mycenaean period in the mid-2nd millennium BCE

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, pulau Samos, yang dalam beberapa kisah adalah tempat kelahiran sang dewi, telah menjadi pusat pemujaannya sejak periode Mycenae pada pertengahan milenium ke-2 SM.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, the island of Samos, in some accounts the goddess's birthplace, had been a centre of her cult as far back as the Mycenaean period in the mid-2nd millennium BCE.

claims.quote: Across Greece, sporting competitions for women, the Heraia, were held in Hera's honour, as were annual marriage festivals (hierogamy) when couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, di seluruh Yunani diadakan perlombaan olahraga perempuan bernama Heraia untuk menghormati Hera, begitu pula festival pernikahan tahunan ketika pasangan memeragakan ulang pernikahan Zeus dan Hera.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, across Greece sporting competitions for women, the Heraia, were held in Hera's honour, as were annual marriage festivals in which couples re-enacted the marriage of Zeus and Hera.

claims.quote: She is most often seated on a throne and sometimes wears a crown (polos), holds a royal sceptre, and wears a bridal veil. On occasion she is also depicted holding a pomegranate, a traditional symbol of fertility.
claims.locator: How was Hera Represented in Art?

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam seni Hera paling sering duduk di singgasana, kadang bermahkota (polos), memegang tongkat kerajaan, dan bercadar pengantin; kadang ia memegang delima, lambang kesuburan.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in art Hera is most often seated on a throne, sometimes wearing a crown (polos), holding a royal sceptre, and wearing a bridal veil; on occasion she holds a pomegranate, a traditional symbol of fertility.

claims.quote: In Roman culture the goddess lived on as Juno, although she principally represented the good family and faithful marriage attributes of Hera rather than the jealous avenger of infidelity.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, dalam budaya Romawi sang dewi hidup terus sebagai Juno, yang terutama mewakili sifat keluarga baik dan pernikahan setia, bukan pembalas dendam yang cemburu atas perselingkuhan.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, in Roman culture the goddess lived on as Juno, who principally represented the good family and faithful marriage attributes of Hera rather than the jealous avenger of infidelity.

claims.quote: Verily have I three cities that are far dearest in my sight, Argos and Sparta and broad-wayed Mycenae

statement.id: Dalam Iliad 4 (terjemahan Murray), Hera berkata kepada Zeus bahwa tiga kota yang paling disayanginya adalah Argos, Sparta, dan Mycenae.
statement.en: In Iliad 4 (Murray translation), Hera tells Zeus that the three cities dearest in her sight are Argos, Sparta, and Mycenae.

claims.quote: crooked-counselling Cronos begat me as the most honoured of his daughters ... in twofold wise, for that I am eldest, and am called thy wife, whilst thou art king among all the immortals.

statement.id: Dalam Iliad 4 (terjemahan Murray), Hera berkata bahwa Cronos memperanakkannya sebagai putri yang paling dihormati, dengan dua alasan: ia yang tertua dan disebut istri Zeus, sedangkan Zeus raja di antara semua makhluk abadi.
statement.en: In Iliad 4 (Murray translation), Hera says Cronos begat her as the most honoured of his daughters in twofold wise: she is eldest and is called Zeus's wife, whilst he is king among all the immortals.

claims.quote: In a note in his Greek Religion, Walter Burkert records scholars' arguments "for the meaning Mistress as a feminine to Heros, Master", with uncertain origin.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Walter Burkert mencatat pendapat para sarjana tentang arti "Nyonya" sebagai bentuk feminin dari Heros, "Tuan", dengan asal-usul yang tidak pasti.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Walter Burkert records scholars' arguments for the meaning "Mistress" as a feminine to Heros, "Master", with uncertain origin.

claims.quote: A. J. van Windekens proposes the meaning "young cow, heifer", which is consonant with Hera's common epithet βοῶπις (boōpis, "cow-eyed").

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, A. J. van Windekens mengusulkan arti "sapi muda", yang sesuai dengan julukan umum Hera, βοῶπις (boōpis, "bermata sapi").
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, A. J. van Windekens proposes the meaning "young cow, heifer", consonant with Hera's common epithet βοῶπις (boōpis, "cow-eyed").

claims.quote: Her sacred animals include the cow, cuckoo, and peacock. She is sometimes shown holding a pomegranate as an emblem of immortality.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, hewan suci Hera mencakup sapi, burung kukuk, dan merak, dan ia kadang digambarkan memegang delima sebagai lambang keabadian.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, her sacred animals include the cow, cuckoo, and peacock, and she is sometimes shown holding a pomegranate as an emblem of immortality.

claims.quote: In the Iliad, Homer tells of another attempted overthrow, in which Hera, Poseidon, and Athena conspire to overpower Zeus and tie him in bonds.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam Iliad Hera, Poseidon, dan Athena bersekongkol untuk mengalahkan Zeus dan mengikatnya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, in the Iliad Hera, Poseidon, and Athena conspire to overpower Zeus and tie him in bonds.

claims.quote: When Tiresias sided with Zeus, Hera struck him blind.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, ketika Tiresias memihak Zeus, Hera membutakannya.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, when Tiresias sided with Zeus, Hera struck him blind.

claims.quote: Hera is the daughter of the Titans Cronus and Rhea, and the sister of Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus.

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Hera adalah putri para Titan Cronus dan Rhea, serta saudari Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, dan Zeus.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Hera is the daughter of the Titans Cronus and Rhea, and the sister of Hestia, Demeter, Hades, Poseidon, and Zeus.

claims.quote: The name Hera (Hḗrā or Hḗrē) is attested in Mycenaean Greek, written in Linear B syllabary as 𐀁𐀨 e-ra, appearing on tablets found in Pylos and Thebes

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, nama Hera (Hḗrā atau Hḗrē) tercatat dalam bahasa Yunani Mycenae, ditulis dalam silabaria Linear B sebagai 𐀁𐀨 e-ra, pada lempeng yang ditemukan di Pylos dan Thebes.
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, the name Hera (Hḗrā or Hḗrē) is attested in Mycenaean Greek, written in Linear B as 𐀁𐀨 e-ra on tablets found in Pylos and Thebes.

claims.quote: Leto was so punished through Hera promising to curse any land that gave the pregnant goddess refuge.

statement.id: Menurut World History Encyclopedia, Leto dihukum karena Hera berjanji mengutuk negeri mana pun yang memberi perlindungan kepada dewi yang sedang hamil itu.
statement.en: According to World History Encyclopedia, Leto was punished through Hera promising to curse any land that gave the pregnant goddess refuge.

claims.quote: but she is, notwithstanding, far inferior to him in power; she must obey him unconditionally

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa Hera jauh lebih rendah daripada Zeus dalam kekuasaan dan harus menaatinya tanpa syarat.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi says Hera is far inferior to Zeus in power and must obey him unconditionally.

claims.quote: Hera is the stepmother and enemy of Heracles. The name Heracles means "Glory of Hera".

statement.id: Menurut Wikipedia, Hera adalah ibu tiri sekaligus musuh Heracles, dan nama Heracles berarti "Kemuliaan Hera".
statement.en: According to Wikipedia, Hera is the stepmother and enemy of Heracles, and the name Heracles means "Glory of Hera".

claims.quote: Hera therefore is not, like Zeus, the queen of gods and men, but simply the wife of the supreme god. The idea of her being the queen of heaven, with regal wealth and power, is of a much later date.

statement.id: Entri kamus yang dimuat Theoi menyatakan bahwa Hera bukan, seperti Zeus, ratu para dewa dan manusia, melainkan hanya istri dewa tertinggi, dan bahwa gagasan tentangnya sebagai ratu surga berasal dari masa yang jauh lebih kemudian.
statement.en: The dictionary entry reproduced by Theoi states that Hera is not, like Zeus, the queen of gods and men, but simply the wife of the supreme god, and that the idea of her as queen of heaven is of a much later date.

short_description.id: Gabriel adalah malaikat agung yang menyampaikan kehendak Tuhan kepada manusia, dikenal dalam Yudaisme, Kristen, dan Islam.
short_description.en: Gabriel is an archangel who announces God's will to humankind and is known in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.

long_description.id: Gabriel adalah malaikat agung yang berkuasa menyampaikan kehendak Tuhan kepada manusia sebagai utusan Tuhan, dan ia dikenal dalam Yudaisme, Kristen, dan Islam. Dalam Kitab Daniel, Gabriel menjelaskan penglihatan-penglihatan Daniel; terjemahan King James menyebutnya "terbang dengan cepat" ketika datang kepada Daniel. Menurut Catholic Encyclopedia, dalam Daniel 8 ia menjelaskan penglihatan tentang domba jantan bertanduk sebagai pertanda kehancuran Kekaisaran Persia oleh Aleksander Agung dari Makedonia.
long_description.en: Gabriel is an archangel who brings God's will to people as God's messenger, and he is known in Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. In the Book of Daniel, Gabriel explains Daniel's visions; the King James translation says he was caused to fly swiftly when he came to Daniel. The Catholic Encyclopedia reads the horned-ram vision of Daniel 8, which Gabriel explains, as pointing to Alexander the Great of Macedon destroying the Persian Empire.

long_description.id: Dalam Injil Lukas, Gabriel memberitahukan kelahiran Yohanes Pembaptis kepada Zakharia; malaikat itu berkata, "Akulah Gabriel, yang berdiri di hadirat Allah." Lukas 1:26 menyatakan bahwa Gabriel diutus ke sebuah kota di Galilea bernama Nazaret, dan ia memberi tahu Maria bahwa ia akan melahirkan Yesus. Banyak cabang Kekristenan, termasuk Ortodoksi Timur, Gereja Katolik, Lutheranisme, dan Anglikanisme, menghormati Gabriel sebagai santo.
long_description.en: In the Gospel of Luke, Gabriel announces the birth of John the Baptist to Zechariah; the angel says, "I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God." Luke 1:26 says Gabriel was sent to a city of Galilee named Nazareth, and he tells Mary that she will bear Jesus. Gabriel is also honored as a saint by many Christian branches, among them Eastern Orthodoxy, the Catholic Church, Lutheranism, and Anglicanism.

long_description.id: Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael berdiri di sisi kanan Tuhan dan Gabriel di sisi kiri-Nya. Michael lebih banyak berada di surga, sedangkan Gabriel adalah utusan Tuhan yang menjalankan kehendak-Nya di bumi. Dalam tradisi Yahudi itu ia berwujud manusia, bersayap seperti semua malaikat, dikaitkan dengan api, dan pergi menghancurkan Sodom serta menyelamatkan Lot setelah menampakkan diri kepada Abraham.
long_description.en: According to the Jewish Encyclopedia, Michael stands at the right hand of God and Gabriel at His left. Michael is more occupied in heaven, while Gabriel is God's messenger who executes His will on earth. In that Jewish tradition he has the form of a man, has wings like all the angels, is associated with fire, and went to destroy Sodom and save Lot after appearing to Abraham.

long_description.id: Umat Muslim meyakini bahwa Gabriel membawa Al-Qur'an kepada Muhammad dengan izin Allah, menurut terjemahan Al-Baqarah 2:97, dan bahwa ia ditugaskan menyampaikan kitab-kitab dari Tuhan kepada para nabi dan rasul. Metropolitan Museum of Art mencatat keyakinan bahwa firman Tuhan disampaikan kepadanya dalam bahasa Arab. Menurut tradisi hadis, Jibril dikatakan memiliki enam ratus sayap. long_description.en: Muslims believe that Gabriel brought the Quran to Muhammad by God's permission, according to a translation of Al-Baqarah 2:97, and that his task was to carry the scriptures from God to the prophets and messengers. The Metropolitan Museum of Art records the belief that the word of God was revealed to him in Arabic. Hadith traditions say Jibril has six hundred wings. In a translation of At-Tahrim 66:4, Gabriel is among those named as assistants of the one whom Allah protects.

short_description.en: Satan is a figure in Jewish, Christian, and Islamic traditions associated with tempting humans; his role differs by tradition, from heavenly prosecutor to rebellious angel or jinn.

long_description.id: Satan, juga disebut Iblis atau Devil, adalah sosok dalam agama-agama Abrahamik yang menggoda manusia ke dalam dosa atau kepalsuan. Dalam Yudaisme ia dipandang sebagai pelaksana yang tunduk kepada Tuhan dan biasanya dianggap metafora dorongan jahat (yetzer hara), sedangkan dalam Kristen dan Islam ia biasanya dipandang sebagai malaikat atau jin yang memberontak. Menurut Wikipedia, sebagian besar orang Yahudi tidak percaya akan adanya sosok supernatural yang sepenuhnya jahat.
long_description.en: Satan, also called Iblis or the Devil, is a figure in the Abrahamic religions who entices people into sin or falsehood. In Judaism he is seen as an agent subservient to God and is typically regarded as a metaphor for the evil inclination (yetzer hara), whereas in Christianity and Islam he is usually viewed as a rebellious angel or jinn. According to Wikipedia, most Jews do not believe in a supernatural, wholly evil figure.

long_description.id: Nama Satan berasal dari bahasa Ibrani ha-Satan, "sang penentang" atau "lawan". Dalam Alkitab Ibrani, menurut Wikipedia, ha-Satan pertama muncul sebagai jaksa surgawi yang tunduk kepada Yahweh. Dalam prolog Kitab Ayub ia datang bersama anak-anak Allah menghadap TUHAN, dan Tuhan menyerahkan milik Ayub ke dalam kuasanya dengan larangan menyentuh Ayub sendiri; dalam Zakharia 3:1 ia berdiri untuk menentang imam besar Yosua. Menurut Jewish Encyclopedia dan World History Encyclopedia, ia hanya dapat bertindak dengan izin Tuhan, dan World History Encyclopedia menegaskan bahwa Satan sebagai sosok yang sepenuhnya jahat tidak ditemukan dalam Alkitab Yahudi.
long_description.en: The name Satan comes from the Hebrew ha-Satan, "the opposer" or "adversary." In the Hebrew Bible, according to Wikipedia, ha-Satan first appears as a heavenly prosecutor subordinate to Yahweh. In the prologue of Job he comes with the sons of God before the LORD, and God puts Job's possessions in his power while forbidding him to touch Job himself; in Zechariah 3:1 he stands to resist the high priest Joshua. According to the Jewish Encyclopedia and World History Encyclopedia he can act only with God's permission, and World History Encyclopedia stresses that a totally evil Satan is nowhere to be found in the Jewish Bible.

long_description.id: Menurut terjemahan King James, Matius 4:1 menyatakan bahwa Yesus dibawa ke padang gurun untuk dicobai oleh Iblis. Wahyu 12 menyebut perang di surga, ketika Michael dan malaikat-malaikatnya berperang melawan naga besar, ular tua yang disebut Iblis dan Satan; ia dicampakkan ke bumi bersama malaikat-malaikatnya. Alkitab tidak melukiskan rupa Satan, tetapi Wikipedia mencatat bahwa sejak abad kesembilan seni Kristen sering menggambarkannya dengan tanduk, kuku belah, kaki berbulu, dan ekor.
long_description.en: In the King James translation, Matthew 4:1 says that Jesus was taken into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil. Revelation 12 describes war in heaven, in which Michael and his angels fought against the great dragon, that old serpent called the Devil and Satan, who was cast out into the earth with his angels. long_description.en: The Jewish Encyclopedia records that in the Talmud and Midrash Satan came into the world with Eve, so that he was created and is not eternal; he is also portrayed as the incarnation of all evil, identified with the impulse to evil. long_description.id: Dalam Al-Qur'an, menurut Wikipedia, Iblis (Shaitan) memimpin para setan; ia terbuat dari api dan diusir dari surga karena menolak bersujud kepada Adam. long_description.en: According to Wikipedia, the Quran presents Iblis (Shaitan) as head of the devils, made of fire and expelled from Heaven for refusing to bow to Adam. A translation of Al-Kahf 18:50 says he was of the jinn, and a translation of Al-Hijr 15:39 records him vowing to make disobedience attractive to people and mislead them.
