short_description.id: Venus adalah dewi Romawi cinta, kecantikan, kesuburan, kemakmuran, dan kemenangan, serta leluhur bangsa Romawi melalui putranya Aeneas.
short_description.en: Venus is a Roman goddess of love, beauty, fertility, prosperity, and victory, and in myth the ancestor of the Roman people through her son Aeneas.

long_description.id: Dalam agama Romawi, Venus dipandang sebagai dewi cinta, kecantikan, hasrat, kesuburan, kemakmuran, dan kemenangan. Mitologi Romawi menyebut Aeneas sebagai putranya dan menghubungkannya dengan leluhur bangsa Romawi. Bangsa Romawi mengadaptasi kisah dan penggambaran Aphrodite Yunani untuk Venus, tetapi satu sumber menyebut Venus juga memiliki wewenang yang melampaui Aphrodite.
long_description.en: In Roman religion Venus is a goddess of love, beauty, desire, fertility, prosperity, and victory. Roman myth names Aeneas as her son and connects her with the ancestry of the Roman people. Romans adapted the stories and imagery of the Greek Aphrodite for Venus, though one source says Venus also held powers beyond Aphrodite.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah, Venus memiliki dua kekasih ilahi utama, yaitu suaminya Vulcan dan Mars. Dengan Mars ia dikatakan melahirkan Timor, Metus, Concordia, dan para Cupid, dan Vulcan pernah menjebak keduanya dengan jaring. Ia juga memiliki kekasih fana seperti Anchises, yang bersamanya ia memiliki putra Aeneas, dan Adonis.
long_description.en: In stories Venus has two main divine lovers, her husband Vulcan and Mars. With Mars she is said to have borne Timor, Metus, Concordia, and the Cupids, and Vulcan once trapped the two lovers in a net. She also has mortal lovers such as Anchises, with whom she has a son Aeneas, and Adonis.

long_description.id: Pemujaan Venus di Roma mencakup banyak gelar. Kuil pertamanya tercatat pada 295 SM untuk Venus Obsequens, dan kuil serta pemujaan Venus Erycina dan Venus Verticordia kemudian didirikan untuk kaum plebeian. Bulannya adalah April, dengan festival seperti Veneralia untuk Venus Verticordia. Pada akhir Republik, tokoh-tokoh seperti Sulla, Pompeius, dan Julius Caesar mengklaim restunya.
long_description.en: Venus was worshipped in Rome under many titles. Her first temple is recorded in 295 BCE for Venus Obsequens, and temples and cults of Venus Erycina and Venus Verticordia were later founded for the plebeians. Her month was April, with festivals such as the Veneralia for Venus Verticordia. At the close of the Republic, figures such as Sulla, Pompey, and Julius Caesar claimed her favor.

long_description.id: Dalam seni, Venus sering digambarkan telanjang, dan banyak patungnya mirip dengan Aphrodite dari Knidos dan Venus de Milo. Dalam Metamorphoses Ovidius ia hadir pada festivalnya di Siprus ketika Pygmalion berdoa, dan ia terluka oleh anak panah putranya sebelum jatuh cinta pada Adonis. Sebuah esai museum menyebut Venus dan putranya Cupid sebagai perwujudan cinta dalam syair.
long_description.en: In art Venus was often depicted nude, and many sculptures resemble the Aphrodite of Cnidus and the Venus de Milo. In Ovid's Metamorphoses she is present at her festival in Cyprus when Pygmalion prays, and she is grazed by her son's arrow before falling for Adonis. A museum essay presents Venus and her son Cupid as embodiments of love in verse.

statement.en: Wikipedia says Cupid and Amor are taken to be different names for the same Roman love-god, the son of Venus, fathered by Mercury, Vulcan or Mars.

claims.quote: Venus has been described as perhaps "the most original creation of the Roman pantheon", and "an ill-defined and assimilative" native goddess

statement.en: Venus has been described as perhaps "the most original creation of the Roman pantheon" and as "an ill-defined and assimilative" native goddess.

claims.quote: Julius Caesar claimed her as his ancestor. Venus was central to many religious festivals, and was revered in Roman religion under numerous cult titles.

statement.id: Julius Caesar mengklaim Venus sebagai leluhurnya; Venus menjadi pusat banyak festival keagamaan dan dipuja dalam agama Romawi dengan banyak gelar kultus.
statement.en: Julius Caesar claimed her as his ancestor; Venus was central to many religious festivals and revered in Roman religion under numerous cult titles.

claims.quote: At the close of the Roman Republic, some Romans laid claim to Venus' favor and competed for it, such as Sulla (adopting the name Felix, Latin for lucky, and accrediting Venus Felix to his divine favor)

statement.id: Pada akhir Republik Romawi, sebagian orang Romawi mengklaim restu Venus dan bersaing merebutnya, misalnya Sulla yang memakai nama Felix (bahasa Latin untuk 'beruntung') dan menisbahkan keberuntungannya kepada Venus Felix.
statement.en: At the close of the Roman Republic some Romans laid claim to Venus's favor and competed for it, for example Sulla, who adopted the name Felix (Latin for lucky) and credited Venus Felix with his divine favor.

user_policy.name: nama-besar
user_policy.intent: Big names (major gods, archangels, demon princes, primordial monsters, famous literary beings) must look imposing and powerful: an epic, awe-inspiring or terrifying presence that matches their standing in the tradition.
user_policy.effects: Visible power effects are wanted and may be strong: blazing solar fire, lightning, storms, floods, underworld flame and smoke, divine radiance, petrifying gaze, cosmic scale. Every effect must come from a power, domain, attribute or deed documented in the research claims of that being (for example Ra and the sun, Medusa and her petrifying gaze). Do not add an effect that the research does not support.
user_policy.fidelity: Anatomy, attributes, number of heads, limbs and eyes, and iconography follow the research claims exactly. Effects add atmosphere and power; they never replace or invent anatomy.
user_policy.composition: Low camera angle, monumental scale with small environmental references, dramatic cinematic lighting, strong silhouette, rich detail; the being dominates the frame. Benevolent deities are majestic and radiant rather than monstrous; malevolent beings are menacing.
user_policy.style: Square premium painterly illustration in the house style of the existing artwork, more dramatic and higher contrast. No text, labels, logo, border or watermark. No gore or nudity.
user_policy.sources: Never copy designs from films, games, anime or comics (modern_depictions). Living religions (Hindu deities, angels, Egyptian revival worship) are depicted with respect.
